column2: Provided that any such direction issued may at any time

column2: (3)  Any person or partnership, who or which is dissatisfied

column1: with a direction issued under this section in respect of any
year of assessment may, within the period of thirty days after
the  date  of  the  issue  of  such  direction,  appeal  to  the
Commissioner-General in writing, setting out precisely the
grounds on which such appeal is being made.  The decision
of  the  Commissioner  General  on  any  such  appeal  shall  be
final  and  conclusive:

column2: Provided that the Commissioner General shall, on a request

column1: made in writing by such person or partnership, as the case

column2: may be, cause an assessment to be made under section 163

column1: on such person or partnership for that year of assessment, for
the purpose of  enabling  such person or partnership to prefer
